{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Display basic info
print('Shape:', penguins.shape)
print('\nColumns:')
print(penguins.dtypes)

print('\nMissing values:')
print(penguins.isnull().sum())

print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(penguins.head())

# Check for duplicates
print('\nDuplicate rows:', penguins.duplicated().sum())

# Check for sentinel values or implausible ranges
print('\nUnique values in sex:')
print(penguins['sex'].unique())

# Check range of flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g
print('\nFlipper length (mm) min/max:', penguins['flipper_length_mm'].min(), '/', penguins['flipper_length_mm'].max())
print('\nBody mass (g) min/max:', penguins['body_mass_g'].min(), '/', penguins['body_mass_g'].max())"}
